🎁 CODES: 1000CCU, 1000LIKES!

🏐🔥 MAKE YOUR OWN SPIKER! 🔥🏐
From an unknown rookie to the player nobody can block. Your rise starts on the court!

🎯 Roll custom traits, mix and match abilities, and craft an unstoppable build.
⚡ Play through the solo-mode story or jump into high-action online matches.
🔥 Master crazy abilities, time your jumps, and dominate the net.
📈 Upgrade your kit, experiment with trait combos, and forge your own playstyle.
⚔️ Take on tough Coliseum bosses or outplay real opponents on the court.
🏆 Grind RANKED, win matches, and climb the global leaderboards!

One clean receive. One perfect set. One unstoppable spike.

👍 Like + Favorite ⭐ to support the game!
🚧 BETA — New updates every weekend!

An high action volleyball game inspired by The Spike Cross.
